provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.1, sections 4.1 and 8; expected bits are computed with exact rational arithmetic.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Exact decimal texts at, just below, and just above binary64 and binary32 rounding midpoints, in both signs: ties to even, the binary64 overflow threshold, subnormal and normal boundaries, and f32 conversion of the binary64 value, including rows where that double rounding differs from rounding the text directly.
